wrappers.words: WRAPPERS are parentheses, as, satisfies, <T>, ! and an instantiation expression's type arguments; every reader reads an expression through every one of them at every use site (unwrap and isWrapper), and the tracer also through await

specifiers.words: the specifier reader names every import declaration's specifier (a type-only one included), every export-from's, every import-equals of an external module's, and every loader call's first argument through resolution, <expression> when it does not resolve or is absent

loader.words: the loader reader reads import(), every call whose callee is spelled with a LOADER_CALLS name (a name, a property name or a literal element name), a LOADER_FACTORIES call's result called directly, and a call of a name that a variable declaration with a plain name, or a BINDING_ASSIGNMENTS assignment to a name, binds to a LOADER_FACTORIES call
each such call whose first argument does not resolve or is absent is read once, labelled as spelled: import(), <callee>(), <factory>()() for a factory result called directly

identifiers.words: the I/O-global reader reads every reference to an IO_GLOBALS name, and every reference to a GLOBAL_OBJECTS name with the member read off it (.name, [text] or [<computed>])
the process reader reads every reference to process but a PROCESS_READS member read (.env or [env])

a reference is an identifier outside a name slot (every predicate isNameSlot tests: a declaration's, a property's or key's, an import or export specifier's, a label's name) and outside a type (inType: a type node; a class's extends expression and an instantiation expression are values, their type arguments types)

tracer.words: entries: every import whose clause is not type-only (a type-only specifier binds nothing), every import-equals that is not type-only and every export-from whose specifier names child_process (CHILD_PROCESS, through resolution), and every loader call whose specifier does
it follows a held value through WRAPPERS and await
member reads by name, by a key that resolves to one text (<computed> otherwise); a default read off the module is the module itself

declarations and BINDING_ASSIGNMENTS assignments to a name or a destructuring pattern at any depth (rest elements, defaults and holes included), the target through WRAPPERS, and the assignment's value
a LOGICAL_ASSIGNMENTS assignment whose target is a held name, through WRAPPERS, is followed through the assignment's value (the target's old value when kept); a member target is a property store
the result of an EITHER_OPERAND operator (??, ||, &&), a comma's right operand and a conditional's arms
a call of a held LAUNCH_CALLS member reads its command (resolution; <expression> when it does not resolve or is absent)
an export of a held value (a declaration, a local export, an export assignment, an exported import-equals, an export-from of child_process) reads <re-export>

a value a statement, void or a comma's left operand discards reads nothing, and so does a name's old value at a write target (every predicate isWriteTarget tests: an =, compound or destructuring assignment's target, a for-in or for-of head, an increment or a decrement, each through WRAPPERS)

every other use reads <reference>: a call of the module or of another member, an argument, a return, a property store, a class field, a class's extends, an element, an operator's operand, a condition, a member path deeper than PATH_DEPTH

a string or template part holding child_process outside a specifier slot (an import's or export's specifier, an external module reference, an ambient module's name, a loader call's first argument) and outside a type reads <untraced>
it reads in rounds, each deepening a binding by one step; a module still binding after TRACE_ROUNDS rounds reads <reference> at its start

launches.words: the launch-call reader reads every call whose callee is spelled with a LAUNCH_CALLS name (a name, a property name or a literal element name) and whose command resolves

and, its command <expression>, every such call in a namespace body or an enum declaration whose command does not resolve, and every such call whose command resolves only by trusting what resolution refuses (an ambient const's initializer, an index into a const array that is not only read)
launchUnion reads both readers' sites, one per call and callee

resolution.words: commands, specifiers and member keys resolve through string literals, a conditional's arms, the const binding a name resolves to in its scope, and a literal numeric index into a const array literal (no spread) whose name is only read; otherwise they do not resolve
resolution follows at most RESOLVE_DEPTH steps (a conditional's arm, a name's initializer, an indexed array and an element are each one step); past them nothing resolves

the nearest scope enclosing the reference that binds the name decides (a block-scoped binding's scope: the block, module, namespace body, case block, for statement or static block holding it; a var's: the nearest function, static block, namespace body or module); a let, var, using, parameter, function, class, enum, import-equals, catch or destructured binding there does not resolve, nor does an ambient const, an ES import or a name nothing in the module binds
every module is read as strict code: a function declaration binds its name in the block that holds it, never in an enclosing function's scope (tsconfig strict)
no name resolves in a namespace body or an enum declaration: TypeScript merges their declarations, and the resolver models neither merge

a const array's name is only read when no declaration of the name is exported or locally exported and every reference to it is an element read, through WRAPPERS, that no assignment (LOGICAL_ASSIGNMENTS included), delete, call or tagged template reaches

scripts.words: a module is parsed by its extension in any letter case: .tsx as TSX, .jsx as JSX, .js, .mjs and .cjs as JavaScript, every other as TypeScript

residuals.words: R-STATIC-FORMS: every form the readers do not parse reads as its quiet row pins

H5-BAND.hollows: BINDING_ASSIGNMENTS without AmpersandAmpersandEqualsToken (the tracer's right-side binding and loaderNames)

H8-ELEM.hollows: calleeName without its literal-element-name branch (the launch-call reader and the loader reader)

H10-CWRAP.hollows: calleeName unwraps only parentheses and instantiation expressions (no type wrapper on a launch or loader callee)
